Sanitized samples supplied by the chief for the usage task.

claude-statusline.json: documented Claude statusLine stdin shape from
https://code.claude.com/docs/en/statusline; not a captured live Claude report.

codex-token-count-weekly-only.json: rate_limits from a real Codex 0.165
token_count event. The account reports its weekly window as primary, with
secondary null; no session window is reported.

codex-token-count-5h-and-weekly.json: derived from that event, with an added
300-minute window to exercise both windows. This variant is synthetic.
